articles.summary: Expro Ltd (NYSE: XPRO) (the “Company” or “Expro”) today reported financial and operational results for the three months ended September 30, 2026. Third Quarter 2026 Highlights Revenue was $440 million Net loss of $5 million and net loss margin of 1.2% Adjusted EBITDA (1) of $91 million with an Adjusted EBITDA margin (1) of 20.7% Cash flow from operations of $65 million, or 15% of revenue Adjusted free cash flow (2) of $52 million The Company increases its 2026 annual Adjusted free cash flow guidance Share repurchases of approximately $9 million (0.6 million shares at an average of $16.14 per share) Liquidity at the end of the quarter stood at $260 million On October 26, 2026, the Board of Directors of the Company authorized a new $100 million share repurchase plan effective immediately and valid through December 31, 2027 Michael Jardon, Chief Executive Officer, commented, “As expected, our third quarter results reflect a sizeable sequential increase from the second quarter.
